reviewer_role: The reviewer authored the new round2 QRF core. This task freshly compares the original frozen QR/KNN code and current manuscript, and is not represented as an independent QRF-code-author review.
scope: Read-only source/protocol/manuscript semantic audit. Standard-library JSON/hash comparisons and PDF text-location extraction only; no numerical forecast, financial-source read, pytest, fitting, archive/source/PDF mutation or external review.

read_ranges.scope: Every function, all 33 coordinates, RMS indexing, exact constant-column scale1 convention, group multipliers, mature pool and neighbor selection.
Actual original QR/KNN entry point, refit loops, fixed transforms/response scales, query features, floor projection, historical controls, scoring, selection and sparse origin grid.
Intercept-required input, mean pinball plus slope-only ridge certificate/objective and actual regularizer/solver calls; no model execution.
Actual StudyConfig construction, original conditional_forecast invocation, independent scorer, validation selection and no-partial-complete policy.
Finite vector validation, corrected-rank integer arithmetic, noninterpolated order statistic and h0-inclusive target cache.
Exact signed position/time columns and unchanged source chronology; no raw source file opened.
Complete original contract, source spans, windows, feature/RMS configurations, penalties, ranks and failure/tie conventions.
Original mathematical information boundary, response scaling, exact distance multipliers, validation and historical-controls interpretation.
Current sections 3-5; JSON source paragraphs and displayed equations, not a new visual review.

checks.finding: 25 signed levels N_t...N_t-24 + abs(N_t) + 2 increment RMS + 2 hour coordinates + 2 Monday-zero weekday coordinates + just-observed gap indicator =33. RMS uses the L increments ending at t, namely N_j-N_j-1 for j=t-L+1,...,t; no future term enters a query row. valid_from=max(24,short,long).

FX RMS spans24/168 and nominalgap3600; Treasury6/26 and604800. Learned coordinate mean/std use only mature training-origin feature rows and population ddof0. Exact repeated training columns are centered at the repeated float and receive unit scale1; any zero std also maps to1. Short/long RMS spans are distinct from these learned standard deviations and from response scale a.

For segment-specific refit r=t0+d*floor((t-t0)/d), pool is exactly W origins r-H-W+1,...,r-H; latest label end is r. Response labels can therefore include the already observed N_r at refit, while predictor rows end at their own historical origins. Pool, transforms, response scale, QR coefficients and KNN response array remain fixed until next refit.

checks.manuscript: Section4 block10 and source budgets Table1
checks.finding: All8 earliest validation pools have their first predictor origins at or above required valid_from. Most demanding FX first origin7560 exceeds168; Treasury first origin46 exceeds26. Later chronological refits have more available feature prefix. Common mature response-origin matching does not imply identical feature lookback lengths.

At actual issue t the floor is abs(N_t), and the query is features.values[t], transformed by the retained refit transform. Between refits, current lag/RMS/calendar/gap features and floor update with t while fitting quantities stay at r. The last training response starts at r-H, so the query target beginning at t is not used as a training response.

Peak begins with abs(anchor) then takes maxima for h1..H; thus target includes h0, G=peak-abs(anchor)>=0 and label_end=i+H. H counts source records, including FX gap-crossing windows; query future target is supplied separately only to scoring, subject to the batch-API limitation below.

a_r=max(mean(G_pool),1e-6*mean(abs(N_pool)),1e-12) in native source units. QR fits y=G_pool/a_r and restores a_r before the nonnegative-headroom projection. All scale inputs belong to the mature pool; current query G_t is not used.

Appended intercept has no penalty. Objective is mean_tau_pinball(y-Xbeta)+lambda/2*dot(beta_slopes,beta_slopes); ridge is not lambda/n, intercept-penalized or L1. Original menu .001/.01/.1 is unchanged. Fitting optimizes unprojected normalized headroom; native-unit validation evaluates final projected peak capacity.

checks.manuscript: Section4 block16 cites frozen group weights and recency tie breaking
checks.finding: Only KNN families apply per-coordinate multipliers: first25 standardized level coordinates /5; RMS, hour and weekday pairs /sqrt2; magnitude and gap unchanged. Squared Euclidean distance is then summed, so corresponding squared-distance coefficients are1/25,1/2,1. Exact distance ties prefer greatest historical origin; selected rows are restored chronologically before ranking. These specific multipliers are public in protocol/code but not enumerated locally in the current manuscript paragraph.

Plain KNN ranks mature nonnegative G using exact integer ceil(19(k+1)/20), duplicates retained and no interpolation. Scaled KNN divides historical G_i by max(shortRMS_i,1e-6*a_r), uses the same neighbor selection, then multiplies by max(shortRMS_t,1e-6*a_r). The common known floor is added at current issue t. At k=W plain KNN equals frozen F under the same order/arithmetic; scaled KNN still normalizes responses.

Actual runner calls original QR/KNN with source.position/source.dates, the fixed StudyConfig and all validation/evaluation origins. Validation uses final C vs P native score .95(P-C)+ +.05(C-P)+, not normalized training objectives. Exact score ties select larger numeric parameter; any failed/incomplete declared validation candidate blocks the family cell. All24 Table2 parameters agree with frozen selection JSON.

F/S/K frozen controls select the same mature response-origin pool at r but keep the actual issue anchor N_t. Rolling controls use r=t at each issue. S ranks reanchored headrooms then adds B_t in the required float-operation order. Matching response pools and update times does not equalize feature lookbacks, local effective samples or training objectives.

Source parsing takes only FX datetime/NetPosUsd and Treasury AsOfDate/Value, rejects nonmonotone timestamps, and does not sort/interpolate/drop gap rows. Hour/weekday/gap use stored naive source clock. This is an economic-date downloaded-vintage Treasury replay, not proof of original-release-time information availability.

limits.classification: implementation capability boundary, not observed numerical leakage
limits.finding: Original conditional_forecast requires len(position)>last_issue+H, validates the full supplied series and precomputes full feature/label caches. Static read shows fitting/query arithmetic selects mature/past rows, but this interface cannot currently issue from an observed prefix alone. A future nonfinite suffix can also stop batch validation. Therefore this audit does not certify a prospective missing-data/online adapter or suffix-independent failure semantics. The manuscript already limits historical replay and separately notes the prospective adapter gap in Appendix K.

limits.classification: documentation completeness gap, no code/text contradiction
limits.finding: The manuscript names frozen group weights and recency tie breaking without listing the actual per-coordinate multipliers or squared-distance expression locally. The complete fixed definition exists in the public original protocol and code. A direct local pointer or one compact explicit definition would improve standalone replication; this audit does not change it.

No new future-perturbation fixture, solver acceptance test, source-data reparse or numerical reproduction was run. Hash agreement proves that reviewed core files equal the original freeze, not that all possible deployment inputs are correct.

mutations: Only this new audit JSON is created. The parent owns any later source clarification or registry/changelog update.
